name: Alcañizo (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over blue with a yellow triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Alcañizo (a bridge and a chequy).
history: Municipal flag of Alcañizo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Alcañizo arms — bridge on yellow, chequy and a tree
